answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 31 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The voyage debit happens at intake, spiral totals the burned amount, and glacier anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. That is 28 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
